text: On a stationary task with forgetting factor mu = 1, RLS drives P toward 0 and the Kalman gain toward 0, so it effectively stops adapting after convergence.
explanation: As the correlation accumulates, P_t -> 0 and therefore the gain k_t -> 0, so updates vanish once RLS has converged. To keep adapting on non-stationary tasks one sets mu < 1, which prevents P from collapsing to zero.
